facts.fact: South Sudan's UNESCO SDG 16.10.2 return describes an access to information legal guarantee that provides for a national Information Commission with oversight, appeals, monitoring, enforcement and mediation roles.
The return says the Information Commission is 'under establishment', with no online request tool, no annual report and no statistics on requests or appeals in 2023.

SSD.note: The document is an access to information survey return and states nothing on digital financial services.
The return says no data protection body is the oversight institution; it states nothing on a data protection authority.
The document states nothing on a data protection law.
